hypothesis.stage_1: multi-hour to multi-day accumulation/persistence of low-oxygen bottom water under vertical stratification
hypothesis.stage_2: short-term shoreward transport/contact of that loaded bottom water with an Eastern Shore shallow-water strip, producing Jubilee behavior when biological detectability is sufficient

stage_1_evidence.result: 9,014 ten-minute rows across three Mobile Bay stations; long low-oxygen-saturation episodes, including approximately 200.7 h below 20% saturation at station 01 and approximately 147 h below 10% saturation; validates persistence/loading as a real state variable

stage_1_evidence.source: NCEI 0176497 July 2016 Mobile Bay vertical CTD surveys
stage_1_evidence.result: 268 profiles; bottom-median DO <2 mg/L in 6 profiles; salinity-gradient AUC 0.866 in descriptive scoring; leave-one-survey-date-out shadow model using gradient+depth+temperature achieved AUC 0.958, Brier 0.0185, log loss 0.0662 with only six positives

stage_1_evidence.source: NCEI 0190491 July 2016 Mobile Bay vertical CTD surveys
stage_1_evidence.result: 31 retained profiles after quarantining one invalid timestamp; salinity gradient inversely related to bottom oxygen saturation (Pearson -0.641, Spearman -0.509); three bottom profiles <20% saturation all on July 11; descriptive gradient AUC 1.0 with very small positive count

stage_1_evidence.source: Park, Kim & Schroeder 2007, Estuaries and Coasts 30:54-65, DOI 10.1007/BF02782967
stage_1_evidence.result: Independent 2004 Mobile Bay time-series literature reports bottom DO closely related to vertical salinity gradient; hypoxia seldom when gradient <2 psu and nearly continuous when gradient >8 psu absent extreme events

Primary mechanism states extensive oxygen-poor bottom-water masses can be forced against the beach, producing Jubilees; canonical event history includes Aug 7-8 1971 Jubilees following extensive Aug 5-6 bottom oxygen depletion

stage_1_assessment: SUPPORTED_AS_PHYSICAL_LOADING_STATE; predictive skill for oxygen loading is demonstrated in two separate 2016 data families, but Jubilee-event skill is not established.

stage_2_evidence.source: NOAA PORTS observed currents vs NGOFS2 Sep 15-17 2026
stage_2_evidence.result: NGOFS2 shows moderate/high correlation for principal-axis oscillatory timing after aggregation/phase adjustment at three upper-bay stations, but vector-direction errors are large (roughly 75-95 deg), sign agreement often near chance, and magnitude bias depends strongly on station/vertical representation.

stage_2_evidence.source: NCEI 0211052 FOCAL AWAC observed current archive
stage_2_evidence.result: 23,664 robust observed current profiles and 7,888 hourly vectors demonstrate km-scale 3-48 h displacement capacity, but offshore FOCAL cannot validate Point Clear shoreline-normal transport.

stage_2_evidence.source: June 12 2024 Point Clear positive / May Day scoped contrast
stage_2_evidence.result: same-morning Point Clear Jubilee and May Day report of nothing with 05:30 local north wind/choppy/muddy conditions strengthens a spatial transport/contact contrast, but incomplete search scope/duration/detectability prevents a clean negative label.

stage_2_assessment: PHYSICALLY_PLAUSIBLE_AND_PARTIALLY_CONSTRAINED_BUT_NOT_PREDICTIVELY_VALIDATED; lack of observed Point Clear current/contact data and zero verified clean matched Jubilee controls prevents event-level scoring.
combined_assessment: The two-stage architecture is now better supported than a one-stage generic weather/tide score because the loading state has independent quantitative evidence and transport/contact is clearly a separate uncertainty. However, event-level discrimination, calibration, false-alert rate, and useful Jubilee lead time remain NOT_ESTABLISHED. Treat the latent states separately in shadow research; do not promote production weights.
highest_value_next_gates: recover observed current data closer to Point Clear/Eastern Shore or a defensible local proxy and score phase/direction/magnitude against model guidance
expand source-backed scoped control mornings with explicit observation effort and visibility
join validated historical event/control windows to available-at-time environmental features without post-event leakage
test whether loading-state probability interacts with short-term transport/wind/tide alignment to improve held-out Jubilee discrimination over loading-only and trigger-only baselines
guardrails: No physical hypoxia observation is itself relabeled a Jubilee.
No same-day report/camera confirmation is used as a pre-event forecast feature.
No uncertain day is converted into a clean negative.
